verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's API and MCP server let an agent draft/create a campaign via natural language (klaviyo-docs-7, klaviyo-docs-9, klaviyo-docs-10), which implies a campaign is created before being sent, but there's no explicit documentation describing a scheduled/queued draft state with a human-approval gate before send. Missing for 10: explicit docs on campaign draft/review states, scheduling API parameters, or an approval workflow between agent creation and send.
